# English Gate (انكلش كيت)

> English Gate is an English academy in Baghdad, Iraq, with its main centre in Adhamiya and online courses for learners anywhere in the world. It teaches kids from 6 to 12, teens from 13 to 17 and adults from 18, including university students and employees, and prepares learners for IELTS and TOEFL. It is not only for children. Founded in 2020; Academy Director: Rusul Thaer (رسل ثائر). Slogan: From Gate to Great (من البوابة… للصدارة).

## How it works
- Every learner starts with a placement test across listening, reading, writing and speaking, in person or over Google Meet.
- New groups start at the beginning of every month; most courses run three months.
- Payment by Qi Card or Zain Cash, in two parts. No cash.
- Parents receive attendance, corrected homework, progress and guidance for home through the academy's app and Telegram.
- A recorded summary of every lecture reaches learners who miss it.

## Programmes
- The level journey (رحلة المستويات): Tracks within one connected journey: every learner keeps moving at their own pace, from first steps to fluency. Each student joins the curriculum that fits their placement test result.
- Smart Start (Smart Start): A strong foundation from the start makes a child learn with confidence, not out of fear, and not by memorising. The whole day runs in English, in person only, with one Arabic lesson.
- School curriculum classes (دروس المنهج الحكومي): Classes in maths and English for the government curriculum and international curricula. The subscription is monthly and runs until the curriculum is finished.
- National exam preparation (التحضير للامتحان الوطني): Preparation for Iraq’s national exam, with classes for each subject. Students register by subject, and each subject has its own price.
- English for adults (انكليزي للكبار): Adult courses run in person and online. A placement test finds your real level first, so you start exactly where you are.
- IELTS and TOEFL preparation (التحضير لـIELTS وTOEFL): English Gate prepares learners for IELTS and TOEFL. The course starts from a placement test, so the preparation begins at your real level.
- New Beginning (الانطلاقة الجديدة): English for every side of university life, plus research using AI and other tools, and presenting in English, so learners speak freely and confidently.
- Private lessons, one to one (دروس خصوصية، واحد لواحد): One teacher, one learner, for children and adults. Placement test first, so you start exactly where you are.
- Level follow-up courses (كورسات متابعة مستوى): Courses and workshops for former students that help them review what they learned and keep practising.
- English for teams (انكليزي لفرق العمل): English Gate trains company staff in English, and coordinates courses with schools. Tell us about your team and we will plan the next step together.
- Monthly workshops (ورش شهرية): Every month brings four workshops: three paid, one each for kids, teens and adults, and one free. The adults have a monthly series on AI with English. Message us to hear about the next one and reserve your seat.

## The level journey (kids and teens)
- Foundation: First steps into English with Jolly Phonics: the 42 sounds and the tricky words.
- Pre-Level One: The Oxford bridge: connecting letters to sounds so reading starts to click.
- Spell and Write 1: The first real reading and writing foundations.
- Spell and Write 2: Stronger spelling, longer sentences, growing confidence on the page.
- Academic Star 1: The start of the flagship series: real conversations begin.
- Academic Star 2: Expanding vocabulary and grammar through lively, guided practice.
- Academic Star 3: Thinking in English: reading, discussing and writing with purpose.
- Academic Star 4: Fluent expression takes shape across every skill.
- Academic Star 5: The summit: confident, fluent English for school and life.

## Questions people ask
### Is English Gate only for children?
No. English Gate teaches kids from 6 to 12, teens from 13 to 17 and adults from 18, including university students and employees, and prepares learners for IELTS and TOEFL. Companies can train their staff with us too.

### Do you prepare for IELTS and TOEFL?
Yes. Preparation for both exams starts from a placement test, so it begins at your real level, and covers listening, reading, writing and speaking.

### Where is English Gate in Baghdad?
The main centre is in Adhamiya, on the first floor, reached by elevator or stairs. It is on Google Maps as English Gate, and the courses also run online for learners anywhere in the world.

### Is there a course for school leavers heading to university?
Yes: New Beginning, for adults and school leavers. Forty lectures of an hour and a half over three months, English plus AI tools, research and presenting in English. It starts on 20 November 2026.

### Do you help with the school curriculum and the national exam?
Yes. School curriculum classes in maths and English run on a monthly subscription, in person, online or hybrid, and national exam preparation covers English, Arabic and computer, with a class for each subject.

### Do you have a programme for ages 4 to 5?
Smart Start is a full day in English for ages 4 to 5, from 8 AM to 2 PM, five days a week, for the whole school year. This school year is full; ask on WhatsApp about the next one.

### Who leads English Gate?
Rusul Thaer, the Academy Director. English Gate was founded in 2020.

### What ages do you welcome?
From age six and up: kids from 6 to 12, teens from 13 to 17, and adults from 18, including university students and employees.

### How is the level decided?
Through a placement test across listening, reading, writing and speaking, in person at the centre or online over Google Meet.

### What curriculum do you use for kids and teens?
One connected journey through trusted international curricula: a Jolly Phonics foundation, the Oxford bridge into first reading, then the Academic Star series all the way to fluent speaking.

### When do courses start, and how long are they?
New groups start at the beginning of every month, and every course runs three months.

### What if a lecture is missed?
A recorded summary of every lecture reaches the learner, so nobody falls behind.

### How do parents follow progress?
Attendance, homework, corrections and progress are shared regularly through the academy's app and Telegram groups.

### How do we register?
Two ways: online through WhatsApp, or in person at the Adhamiya centre. Mansour is a teaching location.

### How do we pay?
In two parts, by Qi Card or Zain Cash.

### Do you run workshops?
Yes: workshops every month, for different ages. Message us to hear about the next one and reserve your seat.

### Can we study from outside Baghdad?
Yes. The online courses run on Google Meet, from anywhere in the world.

### I studied with you before. Is there something for me?
Yes: workshops and level follow-up courses that help you review and practise.

### Which days are you open?
Every day except Friday.

### Do you work with schools and companies?
Yes: courses can be coordinated with schools, and company staff can be trained in English.
